title: Households who possess a household appliance, by appliance type, possession status and year (HAS02)
used_for: U27 plausibility: appliance OWNERSHIP, which `OWNERSHIP_PRIORS` has carried as declared assumptions [A] since Day 5 with the note that 'SAPS publishes no appliance ownership'. SAPS does not, but SILC does: HAS02 gives the share of households possessing a washing machine, clothes dryer, dishwasher, fridge, fridge with separate freezer, deep freeze and microwave. Seven of the nineteen priors stop being assumptions. Declared `validation` and exposure `none`: the priors were set before this table was found, so it can score them rather than merely agree with them. It must stay unexposed - if a prior is ever adjusted against it, its intended_use changes with it.
